nodes.step: unlisted: Implement census logic for :waiting tickets
nodes.assumption: The census can be built by analyzing all :waiting tickets in CairnCommons against the constraint (only waiting-on-another-ticket or waiting-because-cognition are genuine) and integrating the classification logic into transitions.py without further specification of output format, persistence, or invocation mechanism
nodes.would_settle: A decision specifying whether the census is ephemeral (computed on-demand) or persistent, how it integrates with harbor_master show map, and what its output looks like

nodes.step: unlisted: Implement clearing of stale :waiting labels
nodes.assumption: Stale labels can be cleared through transitions.py by removing or transitioning the label, without specification of whether clearing is automatic (triggered by census) or on-demand (called separately from harbor_master)
nodes.would_settle: A decision specifying whether clearing runs automatically after census, is called on-demand, or is triggered by a separate command, and the exact mechanism (field removal, transition call, etc.)

nodes.step: unlisted: Implement census of genuine vs stale :waiting labels in transitions.py
nodes.assumption: The builder will add code to cairn/tools/base/transitions.py that classifies :waiting labels according to the constraint rule (genuine: waiting-on-another-ticket or waiting-because-cognition; stale: all others).
nodes.would_settle: A decision specifying the exact implementation (e.g., 'D1: Add a census/classifier function to Transition class' and when it fires).

nodes.step: unlisted: Implement automatic clearing of stale :waiting labels in transitions.py
nodes.assumption: The builder will add code to cairn/tools/base/transitions.py that removes :waiting labels classified as stale, integrated into the transition system's normal operation.
nodes.would_settle: A decision specifying the clearing mechanism (e.g., 'D2: On each transition, clear stale :waiting labels' or 'D2: Add a background check that clears stale labels').

nodes.step: unlisted: Ticket must provide a decisions field enumerating the build steps
nodes.would_settle: Add a decisions field to the ticket with explicit decisions D1–DN addressing staleness criteria, census implementation, clearing implementation, and proof approach.

nodes.step: unlisted: Define the criteria and detection logic for staleness of a :waiting label
nodes.assumption: A :waiting label is stale if it does not name a genuine blocker (waiting-on-another-ticket or waiting-because-cognition), inferred from the constraint ruling but not explicitly operationalized.
nodes.would_settle: State exactly how staleness is detected: which fields on a ticket determine whether its :waiting label is genuine or stale.

nodes.step: unlisted: Implement census function to classify all :waiting tickets as genuine or stale
nodes.assumption: The census function lives in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py and returns a structure allowing downstream clearing logic to identify stale labels; the exact return shape and invocation are not specified.
nodes.would_settle: Specify the census function's signature, input data source (e.g., harbor_master map or CairnCommons/tickets), return structure, and where it writes results if any.

nodes.step: unlisted: Implement clearing function to remove stale :waiting labels through the transition system
nodes.assumption: The clearing logic in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py uses some existing transition mechanism; which transition class/method and how it is invoked are not specified.
nodes.would_settle: Specify which transition type clears a :waiting label, how the clearing function discovers stale labels, and how it invokes the transition system.

nodes.step: unlisted: Determine proof structure and test fixtures for validating the clearing
nodes.assumption: A proof must demonstrate that all :waiting labels are correctly classified and stale ones are cleared, verified via harbor_master show map; the proof file location, test fixtures, and assertion logic are not specified.
nodes.would_settle: Name the proof file, specify what test data is used (live tickets or fixtures), and state exactly what harbor_master show map output is expected before and after clearing.

nodes.step: unlisted: Run BUILDME crossing once decisions are added
nodes.would_settle: Complete and encode the decisions field first.
